dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Have you heard the name Alex Kim?

explanation: 어렴풋이 기억날 때 That rings a bell.이라고 해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you think about the new rule?

options: It is on me that lunch.
It seems to me that it needs more discussion.
explanation: 의견을 조심스럽게 제시할 때 It seems to me that~을 써요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ___ I think you dropped your wallet.

explanation: 낯선 사람의 주의를 정중하게 끌 때 Excuse me.라고 해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you want pizza or noodles?

options: I'm on the fence about it.
I'm on the same page it.
explanation: 두 선택 사이에서 결정하지 못할 때 on the fence라고 해요.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agreed to lead three projects. ___

options: I hit the nail on my head.
I kept it in my hand.
I bit off more than I could chew.
I went back to my court.
explanation: 감당할 수 있는 것보다 많은 일을 맡았을 때 bite off more than you can chew를 써요.
감사에 가볍게 응답할 때 No problem.이라고 할 수 있어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will the picnic be indoors or outside?

explanation: 상황을 지켜본 뒤 결정하자는 뜻으로 play it by ear를 써요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've sent you the final proposal.

options: the bell is in my hand.
the ball is in my court.
the nail is on my head.
the tea is in my cup.
explanation: 다음 결정이나 행동의 책임이 자신에게 있으면 the ball is in my court라고 해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I have my piano audition today.

explanation: 시험이나 도전을 앞둔 사람에게 Good luck!이라고 격려해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Remember to bring your ID tomorrow.

options: I'll hit that on the head.
explanation: 조언이나 정보를 기억해 두겠다는 뜻으로 keep that in mind를 써요.
